spl: index=wineventlog | stats count by host | sort - count | head 10
kql:
SecurityEvent
| where isnotempty(host)
| summarize ['count'] = count() by host
| sort by ['count'] desc
| take 10
xql:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter host != null
| comp count() as count by host
| sort desc count
| limit 10
